package.description: Free, offline voice-to-text dictation. Press a hotkey, speak, and your words appear in any app — 100% local, powered by Whisper.

en-US.description: Free, offline voice-to-text dictation. Press a hotkey, speak, and your words appear in any app — 100% local, powered by Whisper.
en-US.longDescription:
Eqho is an always-on dictation app that lives in your system tray. Press a
global hotkey (default Alt+Q), speak naturally, and the transcribed text is
typed into whatever application is focused. Speech recognition runs entirely
on your machine via OpenAI's Whisper models (faster-whisper and whisper.cpp) —
no cloud, no account, no API keys. Uses NVIDIA graphics cards (CUDA) and AMD/Intel graphics cards (Vulkan);
PCs without one run on the processor. Includes a live transcription overlay, searchable
local history, custom vocabulary, voice commands, and text replacements.
en-US.name: Eqho
